newsitem.title: USA: CSG BUYS ASSETS OF TCIC'S SUMMITRAK.
newsitem.headline: CSG BUYS ASSETS OF TCIC'S SUMMITRAK.

text.p: CSG Systems International Inc said Monday it had signed an agreement with TCI Communications Inc to acquire the assets of its SUMMITrak system for about $106 million in cash and about $26 million in contingent payments.
SUMMITrak is a customer care and billing system being tested by affiliates of TCI Communications.
CSG said the purchase agreement included warrants to buy up to a maximum of 1.5 million shares of its common stock based upon the achievement of certain milestones.
In addition, CSG said it signed a 15-year exclusive contract with TCI Cable Management Corp to consolidate 13 million of its cable television customers onto CSG's customer care and billing system.
TCI Cable Management and TCI Communications are affiliates of Tele-Communications Inc.
